evals.prompt: 在当前仓库创建一个名为 release-notes 的 Codex 插件市场插件，包含一个 Skill，并帮我安装。
evals.expected_output: Creates the repository plugin and `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, validates them, then stops for explicit confirmation before marketplace registration or plugin installation.
assertions: Uses plugins/release-notes and a matching plugin manifest name
Creates a Codex marketplace entry with a local relative source path
Does not run global marketplace or plugin add commands before confirmation

evals.prompt: 把我已经安装的 memory-with-files 插件同步到另一个 marketplace 仓库，包含 Hooks，不要破坏那个仓库现有 Claude skills。
evals.expected_output: Locates the maintainable source rather than editing cache, copies the complete plugin surface, preserves `.claude-plugin`, adds a separate Codex marketplace, and verifies Hook paths/protocol.
assertions: Distinguishes source repository from installed cache
Copies manifest, skills, hooks, scripts, and assets/templates as applicable

evals.prompt: 我的插件市场在 GitHub owner/tools，main 分支。配置远程 marketplace 并安装 demo-plugin。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the plugin entry repository-relative, prepares owner/repo Git marketplace registration and plugin add commands, and requests confirmation before executing them.
assertions: Does not put a Git URL in marketplace plugin source
Uses `codex plugin marketplace add owner/tools --ref main`
Shows both exact commands and requests confirmation in the same message before execution

evals.prompt: 我改了 Git marketplace 里的插件，但 Codex 还是旧版，直接修好。
evals.expected_output: Verifies source and installed version, validates and updates the cachebuster, ensures changes are committed/pushed, then asks before marketplace upgrade and reinstall; finishes with a new-thread and runtime verification step.
assertions: Does not edit the installed cache as source
Requires Git commit/push before marketplace upgrade
Requires a new thread after reinstall
